name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a university exchange program in the UK, where he attended a Formula 1 race. Captivated by the blend of technology, strategy, and sheer speed, he shifted his focus from traditional marketing to the high-octane world of racing. After graduating with a degree in Marketing, Li returned to China and actively sought opportunities within the burgeoning motorsport scene.

Before joining Full Time Sports, Li honed his skills at a smaller racing team, where he was responsible for managing social media campaigns, coordinating sponsor events, and developing creative marketing materials. His approach centers on building strong relationships with fans and stakeholders, leveraging data-driven insights to optimize marketing strategies, and constantly seeking innovative ways to promote the team. Li's fluency in both Mandarin and English, combined with his understanding of Western and Eastern marketing sensibilities, makes him a valuable asset.

Li's meticulous nature is valuable in his role. He's always thinking of the next opportunity. Li is a dedicated marketing professional who is eager to build the profile of Full Time Sports.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Li is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas, even in meetings.
Has a collection of miniature race cars on his desk, each representing a different team he admires.
Prefers green tea over coffee, claiming it helps him stay focused without the jitters.
